mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, development builds included; no build type is exempt. This sits alongside the project's standing policy of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
